title: ArtifactCodingOutput
description: Structured coding output for one PRE/POST artifact pair. Produced by the artifact-coding skill following the unitization → inventory → cross-product → critique procedure.

coding_unit.description: Identifies the item that was coded. Must match the input.

concept_alignment.description: Optional but strongly preferred. Records unitization, inventories, candidate/rejected alignments, and final matches produced before classification.

unitization_mode.description: Segmentation strategy used before inventory. descriptor_set_special is reserved for Q1a Brand Identity and Q1c Core Values.

pre_concepts.description: Unordered inventory of distinct atomic concepts identified in PRE.

post_concepts.description: Unordered inventory of distinct atomic concepts identified in POST.

candidate_alignments.description: Full (or relevant) PRE × POST cross-product assessments before final selection.

continuity.description: Brief assessment of conceptual continuity / semantic role.

stretch.description: Whether the pairing requires interpretive stretch, and how much.

rejected_alignments.description: Candidate pairings rejected during alignment critique.

matched_pairs.description: Final provisional/global conceptual matches after critique. Cross-position matches are expected. NULL is allowed by omission.

basis.description: Brief statement of why these concepts form a lineage (conceptual role, not position).

unmatched_pre.description: PRE concepts with no plausible POST successor after candidate comparison and full-response search.

unmatched_post.description: POST concepts with no plausible PRE antecedent after candidate comparison and full-response search.

order_only_changes.description: Observed reorderings that were deliberately not coded as semantic events.

new_removed_recheck.description: Mandatory nearest-counterpart search performed before finalizing any New or Removed. Every New/Removed event must have a corresponding entry here.

concept.description: The provisional New or Removed concept being re-checked.

direction.description: Whether the search was for a PRE antecedent (new) or a POST successor (removed).

nearest_counterpart.description: The nearest semantic counterpart found in the opposite response, or null if none exists at all.

codes_tested.description: Transformation codes explicitly tested against the nearest counterpart.

outcome.description: kept = remained New/Removed after all four tests failed. converted = replaced by a matched transformation event.

critic_corrections.description: Audit log of pass-2 critic corrections merged into this draft.

structural_development.description: One whole-response structural judgment for the entire PRE/POST pair.

rationale.description: Concise rationale for this structural judgment. Required unless item is excluded (numeric/grid).

semantic_events.description: Event-level semantic changes. May contain zero or more entries. The same code value may appear in multiple entries for a single response pair.

code.description: The semantic change code for this event.

pre_evidence.description: Brief quoted or closely paraphrased span from the pre-response that identifies the pre-state of this event. Null for New events (no pre antecedent).

post_evidence.description: Brief quoted or closely paraphrased span from the post-response that identifies the post-state of this event. Null for Removed events (no post successor).

rationale.description: Concise rationale explaining the classification. If a decision rule was applied, name it here (e.g., 'applied NARROW-ABSTRACT: Emotion-Appealing → Authentic').

learner_agency.description: Optional. Learner Agency / Metacognition events. Only include if direct textual evidence is present in the artifact. May be empty or omitted.

code.description: Agency code. Current working codes: 'Personal Background', 'Metacognition'. Other codes may be used if evidence clearly warrants it — flag in uncertainty.

evidence.description: Quoted or closely paraphrased span from the text that serves as direct evidence for this agency event.

rationale.description: Brief explanation of why this evidence constitutes the coded agency type.

confidence.description: Coder confidence in this agency judgment. If low, consider omitting the event and noting in uncertainty.coder_notes.

uncertainty.description: Uncertainty record. Always present. Use confidence 'high' and empty flags if no issues arose.

confidence.description: Overall coder confidence in the entire coding output.

flags.description: Named boundary flags triggered during coding. Use controlled vocabulary from decision-rules.md.

coder_notes.description: Free text for anything not captured by flags: residual ambiguity, alternative interpretations considered, items excluded from coding, or any note needed for research auditability.

coded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this output was produced.

model.description: Identifier of the model or coder that produced this output (e.g. 'human', 'MiniMax-M3', 'MiniMax-M3+critic'). Required in calibration outputs.
